Resource Exhaustion: Bound the request size # Read the file in chunks to check size without loading everything into memory immediately content = bytearray() while True: chunk = await file.read(1024 * 64) # 64KB chunks if not chunk: break content.extend(chunk) if len(content) > MAX_FILE_SIZE: raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="File too large.
